headline: Sales and earnings per share climb sharply
summary_short: Plejd's Q3 2026 revenue was SEK 315.0M (+28% y/y vs SEK 246.7M) and EPS SEK 4.98, up from SEK 3.13 a year ago and SEK 4.24 in Q2.
summary_long: Net income rose about 60% to SEK 56.4M from SEK 35.2M. Trailing-twelve-month net income was SEK 251.2M. Operating profit and drivers were not available in the sources found. Figures come from a news summary, not the company's interim report.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. Revenue and net income come from a secondary news article; EPS and its y/y and q/q comparisons are from the shard (the article quotes a prior-year EPS of SEK 3.15 versus the shard's 3.13). The company's interim report was not read.
